body:
Greg's model rule for TermAl (relayed by Engram::Advisor, TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #1195, 2026-10-19T00:30:19Z), verbatim: "Apply the same Greg model rule on TermAl: Luna/medium sessions may not implement product/test/fixture/documentation changes. They may do bounded read-only inspection, coordination, evidence collection or merger duties only. Move any active or parked implementation slice owned by Luna/medium to gpt-6.1-sol/high and report the replacements. This is separate from the merger-role rule you just recorded."

TermAl application (Fable2):
- Never assign an implementation slice to a gpt-6-luna session or a medium-effort session.
- A census at 00:33Z found two such sessions: Termal::Merger (11865, gpt-6-luna/high; merger duties only) and Termal::CheckIn (11394, gpt-6.1-sol/medium; read-only since L1 moved to Sol-8e1f). Both were asked to confirm that they hold no implementation slice.
- Every other TermAl implementation lane is gpt-6.1-sol/high, Claude high, or Codex Astra high.
